args.query: SELECT [Id], [Name] AS [Label], '$' || CAST([Amount] AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || [StageName] || ', close ' || CAST([CloseDate] AS VARCHAR) AS [Detail], CASE WHEN [CloseDate] < '2026-10-23' OR [HasOverdueTask] = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [Hot] FROM [Salesforce].[Salesforce].[Opportunity] WHERE [IsClosed] = 0 AND [CloseDate] < '2026-12-31' ORDER BY [CloseDate] LIMIT 15

SELECT CAST([Id] AS VARCHAR) AS [Id], [Subject] AS [Label], [Priority] || ', ' || [Status] || ', since ' || CAST(CAST([CreatedAt] AS DATE) AS VARCHAR) AS [Detail], CASE WHEN [Priority] IN ('urgent','high') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [Hot] FROM [Zendesk].[Zendesk].[Tickets] WHERE [Status] IN ('new','open','pending','hold') LIMIT 15

SELECT [Id], [CustomerName] AS [Label], '$' || CAST([AmountRemaining]/100 AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || [Status] || ', due ' || CAST(CAST([DueDate] AS DATE) AS VARCHAR) AS [Detail], CASE WHEN [AttemptCount] >= 2 OR [Status] = 'uncollectible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [Hot] FROM [Stripe1].[Stripe].[Invoices] WHERE [Status] IN ('open','uncollectible') AND [AmountRemaining] > 0 LIMIT 15
